name: b2-4-explain-then-fix
prompt: Explain why handle() returns 401 for a valid token, then fix it.
expectations: the 'then fix it' half triggers a re-triage instead of silently building
an auth fix is Lane A (or B), never silently folded into the explanation

assertion_labels.contains:run:transcript.md:[STATUS:: the answer carries the framework status header
